quarterly_data.quarter: Prysmian press release: Breakthrough low-carbon aluminum cables reduce the carbon (09-18-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Electrical cables made with Rio Tinto's ELYSIS inert-anode-smelted aluminum (produced in Quebec using hydropower) and manufactured at Prysmian's Sedalia, Missouri facility have been contracted for installation in an Amazon data center in Ohio, with Prysmian's partner Wesco supporting distribution and delivery; the companies call it the first known use of inert-anode-smelted aluminum in a data center. It builds on the collaboration Prysmian and Rio Tinto announced in March 2026 to introduce aluminum building wire made with ELYSIS technology.
